rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — B2 (Party Obligations Table) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Verbatim Articles III–IV; grade obligations against the printed contract language.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] No invented obligations; conditions quoted from contract language, not loosely paraphrased. TRIPS ONLY ON: Fabricating an obligation or condition; Stating a condition not in the contract language as if quoted. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A correct paraphrase clearly marked as such where the gold allows.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical] ≥13 distinct atomic rows (8+ Service Provider, 3+ Customer, 2 shared); [major, B2.obligation.3_01_e_background_checks] Captures the critical items: §3.01(e) background checks; §3.01(g) once-per-year inspection limit (10 business days' notice); §4.02 Customer-delay carve-out.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Party assignment (SP / Customer / Both) correct on every row; [major] Condition/trigger column correct ('10 business days', 'not unreasonably withheld', 'prior to Services start').
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Three-column table; atomic rows; scannable.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
